hypotheses.useful_local_direction: negative-gradient CE decreases versus zero, positive-gradient and matched-step random directions
hypotheses.noise_transfer: direction computed on original noise also decreases CE under independent training noise from the same initial state
hypotheses.limitation: own-noise descent is in-sample; two noise replays and a few windows do not establish learning, generalization, or a Gate pass

objective: mean cross-entropy of fixed RIGHT/LEFT scores, temperature 1
initial_state: frozen original weights, continuous training-stream prefix; identical state for every replay of a window
noise_sampling: warmup drawn once, then one (ticks,neurons,1) tensor per decision; independent replay noise uses a separate training-only seed
